name: Rowlet
fl: This wary Pokémon uses photosynthesis to store up energy during the day, while becoming active at night.

name: Grubbin
fl: They often gather near places frequented by electric Pokémon in order to avoid being attacked by bird Pokémon.

name: Litten
fl: While grooming itself, it builds up fur inside its stomach. It sets the fur alight and spews fiery attacks, which change based on how it coughs.

name: Popplio
fl: This Pokémon snorts body fluids from its nose, blowing balloons to smash into its foes. It's famous for being a hard worker.

name: Pikachu

atk.x: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

fl: A plan was recently announced to gather many Pikachu and make an electric power plant.

name: Cosmog
fl: Its body is gaseous and frail. It slowly grows as it collects dust from the atmosphere.

name: Crabrawler
fl: It punches so much, its pincers often come off from overuse, but they grow back quickly. What little meat they contain is rich and delicious.

name: Alolan Meowth

atk.x: Flip 3 coins. This attack does 10 damage for each heads.

fl: This Pokémon was not originally found in Alola. Human actions caused a surge in their numbers, and they went feral. They're prideful and crafty.

name: Alolan Diglett

atk.x: Look at the top 3 cards of your deck and put them back in any order.

fl: Its head sports an altered form of whiskers made of metal. When in communication with its comrades, its whiskers wobble to and fro.

name: Cutiefly

atk.x: If any damage is done to this Pokémon by attacks during your opponent's next turn, flip a coin. If heads, prevent that damage.

fl: It feeds on the nectar and pollen of flowers. Because it's able to sense auras, it can identify which flowers are about to bloom.

name: Pikipek

atk.x: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 10 more damage.

fl: This Pokémon feeds on berries, whose leftover seeds become the ammunition for the attacks it fires off from its mouth.

name: Yungoos
fl: With its sharp fangs, it will bite anything. It did not originally live in Alola but was imported from another region.
